hero.title: Invest in Bolivian anticrético from 1,000 USDC.
hero.subtitle: Variable yield. Protected by the public registry (Derechos Reales). On-chain on Stellar.

how.title: How it works
steps: An owner posts a property as anticrético.
Investors deposit USDC into a Trustless Work escrow.
Once the lien is registered, the escrow is released to the owner.
Monthly rent is distributed to token holders via Pollar.
